note: Portuguese translation of the complete 1984 collection, not merely its title essay.

note: Portuguese translation; the 2011 edition follows Marx’s revised 1869 text. Select the German candidate rather than the English or Spanish translations. First published in 1852 as Der 18te Brumaire des Louis Napoleon.

note: Chartier’s institutional bibliography explicitly identifies A aventura do livro as the Portuguese translation of Le livre en révolutions.

note: Portuguese selection of essays by Heloisa Buarque de Hollanda, translated by Sergio Alcides. Not the complete Twilight Memories or Present Pasts. ISBN confirmed in the catalogue for the second edition; first edition appeared in 2000.

note: Journal article, not Davin’s Growing Up Poor. Pagination follows the publisher record.

note: Aristotle’s Politics, composed in the fourth century BCE; exact original year is unknown. ISBN confirmed for the bilingual Portuguese–Greek Vega edition of 1998. The short citation alone does not establish which Portuguese edition was used. No candidates supplied.

original_title: Pour une histoire politique
note: The title identifies the collective volume edited by René Rémond, translated as Por uma história política. Sirinelli contributed Les intellectuels; the cited author string garbles the volume’s responsibility statement. None of his candidates is this volume.

original_title: Ways of Seeing
note: The 1972 BBC/Penguin book made by Berger, Sven Blomberg, Chris Fox, Michael Dibb and Richard Hollis. LCCN confirmed in the library MARC record. Not About Looking, The Look of Things or Selected Essays.
